owner: Cross-Project Knowledge Sync Operators + PMO-2 Memory Ledger Keeper
purpose: Canonical bus that moves lessons from one project or agent cohort into every affected project so worker knowledge stays equal.
rule: A lesson is not system knowledge until it is normalized, assigned to affected projects, has a proof path, and is marked synced or blocked with fallback.

lesson_schema.lesson_type: market_rule | qa_rule | cfo_rule | revenue_rule | design_rule | data_rule | delivery_rule | deploy_rule | anti_duplication_rule

lessons.lesson: EU sellers share the same market grammar even when templates differ: buyer intent, vehicle/part identification, listing quality, price confidence, trust, delivery, return/warranty and seller workflow.
lessons.reusable_rule: Do not copy sellers. Extract repeated workflow rules and convert them into Parts Seller OS decisions.
lessons.qa_check: QA must verify no copied catalogue/design/text dependency.
lessons.next_action: Wire learned fields into Parts Seller OS listing readiness and pricing confidence.

lessons.lesson: Small public seed rows can teach pricing/listing logic only when source_url, checked_at and confidence exist.
lessons.reusable_rule: No source_url + checked_at + confidence means no price/product/revenue decision.
lessons.next_action: Add provenance validation to public-data crawler and Parts Seller OS sample table.

lessons.lesson: Return, warranty, tested state and shipping readiness change buyer trust and price confidence.
lessons.reusable_rule: High-value or risk-sensitive parts without warranty/tested/shipping state require manual review or block.
lessons.qa_check: QA must check listing readiness uses trust states before publish.
lessons.next_action: Create UI readiness badges for warranty/tested/shipping states.

lessons.lesson: EU sellers converge around repeatable category groups: lighting, engine, body, electronics, interior/safety, brakes and cooling/HVAC.
lessons.reusable_rule: Every item must map to a canonical category and required attributes before listing.
lessons.owner: Taxonomy Mappers + CEO-A Parts OS General Manager
lessons.qa_check: QA blocks listing when category or required attributes are missing.
lessons.next_action: Wire category rules into add_part workflow and title/listing generator.

lessons.lesson: More workers do not help when they create duplicate streams. Capacity must attach to owner, task id, output path and proof.
lessons.reusable_rule: Extra capacity becomes review, QA, research, normalization, dedupe or unblock support unless a product gate assigns build ownership.
lessons.qa_check: QA checks for duplicate tasks and vague work outputs.
lessons.next_action: Apply dedupe check to all new learning tasks.

metrics.target_next: Convert queued lessons into Parts Seller OS workflow rules and task-board updates.
